'''Corinathoths''' were massive, slow-moving herbivores native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]].<ref name="CE" /> The Korinatoths were slow-moving, which made these impressively looking creatures quite harmless. During the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]’s [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ziering]]'s expedition encountered a herd of Korinatoths crossing the plains of Maridun, which lumber by, unheeded of the [[Human/Legends|humans]] and their vehicles.<ref name="E16" />
